name: OpenClaw
description: Self-hosted AI agent framework that can manage calendars, browse the web, organize files, and run terminal commands via any LLM.

env.label: Gateway Token
env.description: Gateway authentication token for accessing the OpenClaw web interface

env.label: Anthropic API Key
env.description: API key for Claude models (get from console.anthropic.com)

env.label: OpenAI API Key
env.description: API key for GPT models (get from platform.openai.com)

env.label: Gemini API Key
env.description: Google API key for Gemini AI models (get from aistudio.google.com/api-keys)

env.label: X API Key
env.description: X API key for Grok AI models (get from console.x.ai)

env.label: Nexos API Key
env.description: Nexos AI API key for accessing Nexos AI models

env.label: WhatsApp Number
env.description: WhatsApp phone number with country code (e.g., +12345678900)

env.label: Gateway Port
env.description: Port for the OpenClaw web UI and API gateway

env.label: Bind Mode
env.description: Network bind mode for the gateway
